# Clockwork Content

> Short-form video production. Monthly packs of posting-ready vertical
> videos for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Reels, for creators, small
> businesses and agencies. Long-form editing and daily news videos too.

## Short-form video packs
Every pack includes scripting, standard narration, captions, b-roll and
final rendering. Videos are 1080x1920, vertical, under 60 seconds.

Sale: 30% off every pack until 30 November 2026.
- 10 videos: £84 (£8.40 per video). Normally £120.
- 20 videos: £147 (£7.35 per video). Normally £210.
- 30 videos: £210 (£7.00 per video). Normally £300.
- 50 videos: £280 (£5.60 per video). Normally £400.

## How it works
1. Brief: pick a pack. Share your sources (URL, RSS feed or topic) and your brand colours and fonts.
2. Script: we send hooks and scripts for every video in one batch for you to approve.
3. Produce: voiceover, captions in your brand font, and b-roll matched to each line.
4. Deliver: posting-ready MP4 files.

## Terms
- First videos within 48 to 72 hours of an approved brief or template video.
- Larger packs arrive on a rolling schedule, usually 3 to 5 videos a day.
- Three revisions on the template video.
- You own the videos. Full commercial rights. No watermarks.
- 100% money back if you are not happy after three revisions on the template video.
- Paid extras: voice cloning, auto-publishing and scheduling.
- Payment: bank transfer, card, PayPal or Bitcoin.

## Other services
- Long-form editing and production for YouTube, podcasts and interviews. Quoted per project.
- High-volume daily news updates and recurring series. Quoted per project.
